pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 1

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

4. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 55

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 19
   C. 60
   D. 38

9. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 18

10. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 50
   C. 10
   D. 11

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

12. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 2, 4, 6

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 15

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

15. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

17. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 30

20. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

22. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

23. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

24. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

25. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

26. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 3
   D. 21

27. Solve for x: x + 8 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 14

28. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

29. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 15

30. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
